name: Tap~puri Ijitte Ageru♪ ~Chiisaku Natte Cool Beauty na Kikyou Onee-chan ni Shiborare Tsukusu Itazura Kozukuri~
original_name: たっ～ぷり弄ってあげる♪ ～小さくなってクールビューティーな桔梗お姉ちゃんに搾られ尽くすイタズラ子作り～
source:
His three lovely neighbors were like big sisters.
He longed to embrace them but couldn't say it, so the second eldest slipped him a drug to relax.
The drug unexpectedly shrunk him from man to boy-size. Now he's cuter than ever!
Which of the sister should look after the reduced protagonist? He chooses cool, sexy Kikyou, and his sweet babymaking life begins!

The cool beautiful middle sister of the three, Kikyou lovingly takes care of
you until the drug wears off. More than a sister she dotes on you like a mother!
But mama's horny, and now's the time to live out a boyhood fantasy. Fill her deep with man-sized c*ck!
She may be cool on the outside but she's warm, wet and sweet on the inside...

Soon you'll be a boy no more... until then let responsibility be damned!
Cream her wanton hole with daddy juice!! Make the family that will keep these
hot, hot, hot sisters in your life forever!

[Adapted from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE109461.html]DLSite English[/url]]
